required_systems: trained Naive Bayes or equivalent text baseline
Colab/T4 transformer span-to-intent path or documented negative result path
notes: These criteria are for a clean Week 2 speech-and-intent handoff, not an end-to-end mission benchmark.
The fresh benchmark must be collected after the current parser/model state and must not overlap existing command, span, or audio transcript text.
Passing this gate does not mean language understanding is solved; it means Week 2 has a cleaner frozen benchmark for downstream modules.
